newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurer Amplico 9-mth net profit soars.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurer Amplico 9-mth net profit soars.

text.p: Polish insurance company Amplico Life net profit rose to 7.5 million zlotys in the first nine months of 1996, from 2.5 million zlotys in the same period last year, the company said in a statement.
It said its gross premium grew in the three quarters to 140.8 million zlotys from 52.8 million in 1995.
It said revenues from investments rose to 18.3 million zlotys from seven million last year.

Amplico Life, which has about a seven percent share in the Polish life insurance market, is 55-percent owned by American International Group Inc (AIG) and 45-percent by Poland's state-owned bank Pekao SA.
